angle: Certifiability as the field (C-81/82/83). The shadow question: does written content at region C change what an external agent can certify about a disjoint region A — through shared boundary structure, the shared bath, or the shared clock W = tau/t_epoch. The angle's trap, faced first: on exact stabiliser venues CERT = cut-rank is configuration-independent BY CONSTRUCTION, so the static corner arm is a provable null, and the instrument must live where C-83 already located the clock — the amended clauses, carrier ⊗ bath, finite W.
name: CERT-SHADOW — the certification-shadow instrument
summary: CERT-SHADOW splits certifiability into a static arm and a dynamical arm. The static arm is a theorem to prove and carry as the instrument's exact zero: on stabiliser venues, CERT(A) = cut-rank (C-81) depends only on the code and the region — content enters nowhere — so DEF-A's corner has no field side through certifiability, mirroring C-80's zero-beyond-contact exactly. The dynamical arm defines CERT_dyn(A; t) = chi(R_A : accessible bath fragment) in bits, computed through the URM's own formation machinery within the durability window W (C-83's clock), and reads the field-side quantity SHADOW(A←C) = CERT_dyn(A | C written) − CERT_dyn(A | C unwritten) at fixed instrument, as a function of amount and earned separation. Scratchpad exploration on the URM already exhibits the mechanism: a −0.38-bit shadow at access-contact, resolved smaller shadows at access-distance 2–3, an exact machine-zero on disconnected access geometry, and a Z2 gauge artifact (paired writes cancelling exactly) now named as a mandatory control. The large-N aggregate is the two-lump certification deficit DEF_W(A,C; d) = CERT_dyn(A∪C) − CERT_dyn(A) − CERT_dyn(C) — O-39's minimum ask with bits substituted for energy, because bits are the currency this surface has earned (D-24) and energy is not.
probe: A half-written reference record bit R_A at region A: a record satisfying the clauses (found first-principles by RecordModel.records(), never inserted), prepared maximally mixed over its two values — half-written so that certification has something to certify; a definite-valued probe gives chi = 0 structurally. It couples to the shared bath/access structure through its own declared read channel only. "Away" = positive earned separation: carrier-side d_W region separation (C-78 lineage, the C-80 lane's earned-separation convention), reported ALONGSIDE access-geometry hops, with the relation between the two an output. The access-geometry distance is a declared quantity at first-computation tier and is named plainly as the one new concept needing earning — its earning route is the world tier, where the access geometry is not chosen but counted (C-82: the binding cut is the first grain layer, census data).
observable: CERT_dyn(A; t) := chi(R_A : accessible bath fragment) in BITS — Holevo information the exterior-accessible environment holds about the probe's record value, computed exactly by the URM (RecordModel.evolve once per configuration, env.holevo per fragment), read at times within the window W = tau/t_epoch. The field-side reading: SHADOW(A←C; d, N_C, t) = CERT_dyn with C written minus CERT_dyn with C unwritten, same couplings, same bath, same clock. Companion readouts from the same evolution: whole-bath chi, per-fragment redundancy profile (F-21 machinery), and the two-lump deficit DEF_W(A,C; d). Units: bits and epochs — the surface's own certification currency, not energy; this answers O-39's units complaint in program-owned vocabulary.
response_claim: The claim is existence, never shape: SHADOW is nonzero above the measured noise floor at some positive earned separation, and varies measurably with the amount written at C and with separation. Sign, magnitude, monotonicity, and reach are all outputs — exploration already shows the sign flipping between venues and between read times (consumption-shaped negative shadows at t=2, mixed signs at t=4), which is precisely why no direction or falloff form may be pre-registered. Both verdict directions are computationally achievable (D-8): the disconnected access geometry gives an exact zero, the connected one gives −0.38 bits at contact and ~10^-2 bits at distance 2–3 on the toy. A contact-only result is a real verdict (C-80-shaped: reach belongs to the coupling/access structure), not a failure.
controls: (1) D-15 unwritten surface: C unwritten, same table, always. (2) Probe-only and no-probe: chi = 0 structurally when A holds no half-written bit; baseline chi > 0 when it does — the instrument demonstrably reads content. (3) Coupling-footprint control: C-attachment present + C unwritten vs C-attachment absent — the infrastructure's own footprint reported beside the shadow; the shadow itself is written-vs-unwritten at FIXED attachment, so it cannot be the attachment's artifact. (4) Disconnected-geometry exact null (g = 0): machine-precision zero carried in the same table — the factorization theorem beside the live reading. (5) Gauge/sign controls: opposite-value write, and the paired-write cancellation check — exploration found paired writes cancelling EXACTLY under a gauge-symmetric bath; the registered venue must break that symmetry physically (transverse bath structure, unequal energies) or scope the result. (6) D-8 noise floor: the same difference computed between two irrelevant-microstate variants of the unwritten surface; verdicts only above it. (7) Amount ladder N_C = 1, 2, 3 at fixed separation. (8) Window declared before the run — the observed t-dependence of the shadow's sign makes post-hoc window choice a cheating channel; W is fixed in the brief per C-83's clock discipline.
venue: First: the URM itself — D=1 ring carrier n = 5 (dim 32), records from RecordModel.records(), URM Environment extended with a declared bath adjacency (access-geometry chain + symmetry-breaking transverse term), nq = 5 (dim 32); total dim 1024, exact eigendecomposition throughout, seconds per configuration, minutes for the full grid — smaller and exact. Registration venues after viability: the toric-2x2 (the canonical record venue, two logicals) and an amended-clause world carrier (macrospin-CoCrPt / NAND access geometry) so the T-9 two-carrier discipline is met; the corner-arm theorem runs on T-43's exact F2 machinery at L = 3..5. Exploratory-tier numbers are instrument-viability only and are never registered as surface findings; the registered run carries a CHOICE LEDGER for every declared quantity (bath adjacency, g, hx, lam, W, attachment map) and a TOY_SEPARATION statement.
meaning: FIELD SIDE EXISTS: SHADOW clears the floor at positive earned separation, survives the coupling-footprint and gauge controls, on two structurally different carriers — the record surface then owns an influence-at-a-place observable in its own currency, and its aggregate (DEF_W over the world tier's counted access geometry) is exactly the boundary-shaping-term vocabulary C-77's emergence claim names. NEGATIVE CLOSURE: the corner-arm content-independence theorem PLUS shadow at floor everywhere on connected amended venues across the declared geometry sweep — certifiability is then a source-grade quantity only; combined with the sibling designs' verdicts, T-51's second DONE_WHEN branch fires and T-17 carries the exhibitable-not-provable sentence. THE DISCRIMINATING MIDDLE (and the likeliest): shadow nonzero only at access-contact — the certification field is contact-limited exactly as pure-Gamma structure was (C-80), which relocates O-39 to the aggregate tier and says the field side, if it exists, is a property of shared certification infrastructure at scale, not of the record level — consistent with the fixed shape of the emergence claim, and registered as such with a named next step (the world-tier counted-geometry aggregate).

first_computation: Two arms, both exact. ARM 1 (corner, cheap, run first): prove and verify that CERT(A) = cut-rank is configuration-independent on stabiliser venues — one-page F2 argument plus computational verification with LANE_T43_A_CORNER machinery at toric L = 3..5, every region class, both written and unwritten configurations; output: the instrument's exact structural zero, registered as the corner-tier arm. ARM 2 (dynamical, the live one): D=1 ring n = 5, Ising ring H, probe record at site 0 half-written; bath nq = 5 with declared chain adjacency g = 0.5, transverse hx = 0.35, unequal energies, beta = 2.0; couplings Z_site ⊗ X_bath, private attachment site j ↔ bath j; total dim 1024, one exact evolve() per configuration reused across fragments. Grid: C at carrier separations giving bath-distances 1..4 × amounts N_C ∈ {1,2} × t ∈ {1,2,4,8} with W declared up front × lam ∈ {0.4, 0.8, 1.6} — roughly 200 evolutions, minutes on this machine. Output table: SHADOW (whole-bath and probe-fragment) per cell, with the noise-floor row, the coupling-footprint row, the g = 0 exact-null row, and the gauge pair-cancellation check in the SAME table. The verdict the output decides: any cell clearing the floor at bath-distance ≥ 2 → instrument viable, proceed to the two registration carriers; all cells at floor beyond contact → the contact-only verdict, register with the two structural zeros and relocate to the world-tier aggregate; all cells at floor everywhere including contact → the angle's negative return, register the obstruction plainly.
honest_risks: (1) The corner arm is provably null, so everything rides on the bath arm — which risks being C-47's bath mediation dressed in bits: the shadow may at bottom be a bath-energy reading, and whether "the bath's connectivity" counts as the surface's field side or as yet another source-side quantity is a judgment C-77 must absorb; the footprint control narrows but cannot fully close this. (2) The access geometry is DECLARED at first-computation tier, not earned — every reach statement is conditional on the declared adjacency until the world tier's counted geometry replaces it, and that earning step may fail because world-tier dynamics is not exactly computable. (3) Z2 gauge structure on small venues manufactures both false zeros (paired-write cancellation — observed exactly in exploration) and potentially false positives; symmetry-breaking is itself a declared choice. (4) Finite-bath capacity competition may dominate and vanish as the bath grows — the nq sweep that separates capacity-consumption from dynamical-patterning doubles cost per qubit and may be unaffordable past nq = 6. (5) At reachable sizes the separation ladder has 3–4 rungs and the far-rung shadow (~10^-2 bits) sits amid t-dependent sign oscillations — "responsive, reach undetermined" is a live and disappointing outcome. (6) The shadow's t-dependence invites window-shopping; the pre-declared W is the only guard, and it is a declaration, not an earning. (7) If the verdict is contact-only, D-1 forbids reading that as failure, but the program still lacks action-at-separation, and this angle then ends where C-80 ended — the honest register entry being that certifiability yields a contact law and the field side, if anywhere, is in the aggregate.
